ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels corresponding to scar tissue and surface marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are mapped as fine linear filaments (scratches) and small localized clusters (scars) distributed across the mid-to-distal regions of both lobes, contrasted against a uniform low-intensity black background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45-55 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 20-25% into the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged boundary; continuous extraction reveals frequent high-amplitude peaks and deep valleys (serrations) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins display a consistent concave upward-and-outward sweep from the water line to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity punctate pixel groups localized on the far left distal tip, consistent with barnacle attachment; smaller scattered clusters visible on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); multiple sets of parallel lines are clearly visible on the upper-central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme fragmentation and deep serrations along the trailing edge indicating significant physical trauma; dense coverage of linear and punctate white scars across the entire visible ventral surface.
